name: opencode-dsh-web
description: Open the OpenCode and DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web UIs in a VS Code sidebar, locally or optionally as Coder workspace apps. Pre-authenticated, at your project and last chat.

commands.title: OpenCode Web: Open in System Browser
DSH Web: Open in System Browser

opencodeWeb.mode.description: OpenCode source: 'local' uses opencodeWeb.serverUrl; 'coder' uses an OpenCode Coder app; 'auto' chooses Coder when dshWeb.coder.workspace is set, otherwise local. Coder connection settings come from dshWeb.coder.*.

opencodeWeb.serverUrl.description: URL of the local OpenCode server (opencode serve / service) in local mode.

opencodeWeb.password.description: OpenCode server password. If empty, it is read from ~/.config/opencode/service.json.

opencodeWeb.autoStart.description: Start 'opencode service start' automatically when the server is unreachable.

opencodeWeb.deepLink.description: Jump to the last chat of the current workspace folder: always, only on the first open per workspace, or never.

opencodeWeb.syncAppearance.description: Share the OpenCode web UI appearance (theme, color scheme, fonts) across VS Code windows and workspaces.

opencodeWeb.syncPreferences.description: Also share general preferences, keybindings, notifications, sounds, language and motion tuning. Project permissions and workspace lists stay local.

opencodeWeb.openOnStartup.description: Focus the OpenCode panel automatically when a VS Code window starts.

opencodeWeb.coder.appSlug.description: Coder app slug that serves the OpenCode web UI (coder mode).

opencodeWeb.coder.directory.description: Remote directory used for OpenCode sessions and deep links in Coder mode. Empty: the local workspace folder path.

opencodeWeb.coder.password.description: OpenCode Basic password inside the Coder workspace. Empty: use opencodeWeb.password or ~/.config/opencode/service.json.

dshWeb.openOnStartup.description: Focus the DSH panel automatically when a VS Code window starts.

dshWeb.sessionId.description: Advanced: open this DSH session when the panel loads.

dshWeb.mode.description: Where the DSH panel opens: 'auto' uses Coder when a deployment and session are found, otherwise the local DSH server; 'coder' or 'local' force one.

dshWeb.url.description: URL of a local DSH web GUI (dsh-host-webserver), used in 'local' mode.

dshWeb.profile.description: DSH profile to boot when the local web GUI is unreachable and autoStart is on (for example 'web').

dshWeb.autoStart.description: Start 'dsh --profile <profile> --no-open' automatically when the local web GUI is unreachable.

dshWeb.coder.url.description: Coder deployment URL. Empty: read from ~/.config/coderv2/url (the Coder CLI or VS Code extension).

dshWeb.coder.sessionPath.description: Path to the Coder session-token file. Empty: use the freshest session under ~/.config/coderv2 or the coder-remote global storage.

dshWeb.coder.token.description: Coder session token to use directly, overriding sessionPath. Prefer logging in: the token expires.

dshWeb.coder.appSlug.description: Coder app slug to open. Empty: auto-detect from the running workspace's apps (use 'DSH Web: Select Coder App' if it asks).

dshWeb.coder.appDomain.description: Domain workspace apps live on. Empty: the Coder deployment host.

dshWeb.coder.workspace.description: Coder workspace name. Empty: auto-detect ($CODER_WORKSPACE_NAME, the only owned workspace, the only running one, or the most recently used).

dshWeb.coder.owner.description: Coder username that owns the workspace. Empty: the logged-in user.

dshWeb.coder.agent.description: Coder agent name to include in the app URL. Empty: omit it (slug--workspace--owner).

dshWeb.coder.autoStartWorkspace.description: Start the Coder workspace automatically when it is stopped (otherwise the panel shows a Start button).

dshWeb.coder.cli.description: Path to the coder CLI used by 'DSH Web: Coder Login'. Empty: auto-detect in the coder-remote global storage, then PATH.
